assumptions.text: Acceptance criteria will be confirmed in writing before the related deliverable is baselined.

No deemed acceptance timeline is drafted without an agreed review period.

The draft does not commit to Target go-live on 2026-12-15 absent approved plan evidence.
Production deployment and post-go-live support are outside this first-phase drafting scope.

selected_clauses.title: Limitation of liability
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Mutual aggregate liability is capped at fees paid or payable under this SOW; indirect, consequential and special damages are excluded except where the MSA expressly says otherwise.

selected_clauses.title: IP ownership
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Pre-existing materials, accelerators and know-how remain provider property; after payment, the client receives a license to use deliverables for internal business purposes.

selected_clauses.title: Payment terms
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Fees are billed by milestone or monthly in arrears as stated in this SOW; undisputed invoices are due net 30; taxes and reimbursable expenses are excluded unless listed.

selected_clauses.title: Termination
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Either party may terminate for uncured material breach after notice and cure period; client pays for services performed and approved non-cancellable commitments through the effective date.

selected_clauses.title: Warranty and disclaimer
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; except for express SOW warranties, all other warranties are disclaimed to the extent permitted.

selected_clauses.title: Change control
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Changes to scope, timing, dependencies, assumptions or fees require a written change order signed by authorized representatives before work proceeds.

selected_clauses.title: Acceptance
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Deliverables are accepted against written acceptance criteria; the client has five business days to reject with specific defects; silence after the review period is deemed acceptance only where objective criteria are defined.

selected_clauses.title: Data protection
selected_clauses.approved_clause: Each party follows the data protection addendum and agreed security schedule; data-related remedies and indemnities remain subject to the MSA/SOW liability framework unless QRM approves otherwise.
